info.description: One programme item within an event — a single workshop, showcase, conversation or experience. The public reads it as an "Event".

__.note: Admin metadata for this schema. Strapi ignores this key; src/this/admin-metadata reads it and writes it into the content manager's stored configuration on every boot.

edit.label: Name
edit.description: What this session is called. It is the page's heading, and the page's URL is derived from it.

edit.label: Standfirst
edit.description: A short introductory line, shown beneath the name in the masthead. Not rendered when the page uses the one-column layout.

edit.label: Cover
edit.description: The picture in the masthead, beside the name.

edit.label: Page shell
edit.description: The site chrome that wraps this page. Left empty, it fills itself from the default page shell.

edit.label: Event
edit.description: The event this session belongs to. Left empty on a new session, it fills itself with the main event. A session is archived when its event is.

edit.label: Category
edit.description: What kind of session this is. It decides the page's colour and where the back link goes.

edit.label: Instances
edit.description: Every time this session runs, one row each. A session running on three days has three instances.

edit.label: First date
edit.description: Derived from the instances. Not editable.

edit.label: Last date
edit.description: Derived from the instances. Not editable.

edit.label: All day
edit.description: The website reads "All day" instead of the times. The instances keep their times either way, because a calendar entry still needs them.

edit.label: Price
edit.description: In rupees, with no symbol. Zero reads as "Free"; left empty, no price is shown at all.

edit.label: Venue
edit.description: Where it happens. The label is the place's name and the URL points at a map.

edit.label: Age group
edit.description: Who this session is suitable for.

edit.label: Booking link
edit.description: Where a visitor reserves a place. Independent of the price — a free session can still need one for capacity.

edit.label: Main region
edit.description: The session's own content, below the masthead. Only sections go here — background, spacing and anchoring all live on the section.

edit.label: Collaborators
edit.description: The people taking part in this session. Their events lists — used by the collaborators listing — are derived from published sessions, so a collaborator added here only appears in an edition once this session is published.
